schema.title: Four Keys to More Emotion Without Story
schema.description: The Four Keys unlock emotion with: 1. Hard Fun (challenge, strategy, problem solving; Frustration and Fiero), 2. Easy Fun (intrigue and curiosity; Wonder, Awe and Mystery), 3. Altered States (internal sensations such as Excitement or Relief), 4. The People Factor (social experiences; Amusement, Schadenfreude and Naches).
